decisions.question: The intake record's Produced ledger is empty. HSDD has hsdd-checkpoint append the phases whose Scope cites the record, and lets grafts and bumps be appended by hand. What does the orchestrator write, and does the record close?

options.label: Append the bumps, touched contracts, ADRs and nodes by hand; leave phases to the checkpoint; keep the record open
options.consequence: The ledger shows the unit of work now; closure follows HSDD's rule (every listed phase has a verification doc), which no phase meets yet.

options.label: Also list every rewritten and appended phase now
options.consequence: A fuller ledger today, but it pre-empts the checkpoint's job and would list phases the record cannot close on until they ship.

decisions.chosen: Append the bumps, touched contracts, ADRs and nodes by hand; leave phases to the checkpoint; keep the record open
decisions.why: The record format says hsdd-checkpoint appends phases from Scope citations and that grafts and bumps may be appended by hand; the rewritten and appended phases already name the record in their Scope, so the checkpoint will find them.
